run_deps_table_update: run python setup.py deps_table_update to regenerate the dependency versions table
build_wheel: run python setup.py bdist_wheel to build a wheel distribution for the speechbox package
build_source_distribution: run python setup.py sdist to build a source distribution tarball for the speechbox package
deps_list_function: call deps_list with package names to get their versioned dependency strings from the deps table
review_deps_dict: review the deps dictionary to check versioned dependency mappings for the speechbox package
